records.label: spacr.ops_engine._phenotype.usable_under#3
records.source: A WELL IS NOT OPENED TO COMPOSE A WINDOW OF IT. Six anchors need about nine tiles each; testing readability over every placement instead pulled all 333 of the reference well's sequencing tiles, and ``tifffile`` reads the whole five-plane 1,480 px file for one plane of it -- 22 MB each, about 7 GB over NFS per well, before ``compose_window`` then re-read the nine it wanted. The overlap test is the same rounding ``compose_window`` uses, so a tile is offered here exactly when it would have been used there; a tile that will not read is dropped so the composer never sees a None.
records.context: A well is not opened to compose a window of it. Six anchors need about nine microscope image fields each; testing readability over every placement instead pulled all 333 of the reference well's sequencing microscope image fields, and ``tifffile`` reads the whole five-image layer 1,480 px file for one image layer of it -- 22 MB each, about 7 GB over NFS per well, before ``compose_window`` then re-read the nine it wanted. The overlap test is the same rounding ``compose_window`` uses, so a microscope image field is offered here exactly when it would have been used there; a microscope image field that will not read is dropped so the composer never sees a None.
records.translation: 창 하나를 합성하려고 웰 전체를 열지는 않습니다. 여섯 개의 앵커는 각각 약 아홉 개의 타일이 필요합니다. 대신 모든 배치에 대해 읽기 가능 여부를 검사했더니 기준 웰의 시퀀싱 타일 333개를 모두 가져왔고, ``tifffile``은 평면 하나를 위해 다섯 평면짜리 1,480 px 파일 전체를 읽습니다 -- 각 22 MB, 웰당 NFS로 약 7 GB이며, 그 뒤 ``compose_window``가 원하는 아홉 개를 다시 읽었습니다. 겹침 검사는 ``compose_window``가 쓰는 것과 같은 반올림이므로, 타일은 그쪽에서 쓰였을 때에만 정확히 여기서 제공됩니다. 읽을 수 없는 타일은 버려지므로 합성기는 None을 보지 않습니다.
